highlighted_text.text: The FDA’s decision provides independent validation of Theranos’ patented finger stick and venous blood testing technology and the ground breaking Theranos System upon which the HSV-1 IgG test is run
In order to realize our vision of early detection, lab tests must meet the highest quality standards — standards that are comprehensively set by FDA

Specifically, Theranos provided study data from 818 subjects of varying age and ethnicity, demonstrating that its system could be run accurately using only a finger stick as well as a traditional venous draw across large numbers of Theranos devices, all compared against an FDA cleared, commercially
Theranos’ HSV-1 studies included matrix comparison studies across sixty-nine Theranos devices
Theranos is deeply committed to transparency in the laboratory testing space
Theranos’ HSV-1 test costs $9.07 and is one of 153 tests Theranos makes available for less than $10
Theranos, Inc. is a consumer health technology company founded in 2003 by Elizabeth Holmes

facts: Theranos received FDA clearance for its test system and test for herpes simplex 1 virus IgG on July 2, 2015.
The FDA clearance includes the use of Theranos Nanotainer Tubes for sample collection from a finger prick.
Theranos provided study data from 818 subjects of varying age and ethnicity for its application.
Theranos was founded in 2003 by Elizabeth Holmes.
Theranos offers lab tests in its Wellness Centers in Arizona and California.
